The whole idea, in five lines

五句话讲清楚

A machine has already sorted every file. This app is where a person checks that sorting, and marks where it was wrong.

机器已把每个文件分好类。这个应用供人核对， 并标出机器判错的地方。

  • The machine goes first. Every file already has an answer.
  • Mark only what is wrong. Leaving a row alone is agreement.
  • Confirm once per submission. Until then, an untouched row means nobody has read it.
  • A submission nobody confirmed counts for nothing — however many rows you marked.
  • The comment is how a rule gets changed. Describe the problem; do not quote the document.
  • 机器先做。每个文件都已有答案。
  • 只改判错的。不动某一行，就是同意。
  • 每份 Submission 确认一次。在此之前，未改动的行表示无人看过。
  • 未经确认的 Submission 一律无效 —— 无论标记了多少行。
  • 备注是改规则的依据。写明问题，不要摘录文件原文。

RWhat is your role你的角色与职责

Find yourself here first. Most of what follows depends on which of these you are.

请先在这里找到自己。后文大多取决于你属于哪一个。

Reviewer

审阅人（reviewer）

Signs in as reviewer. Sees only what was assigned to them.

以 reviewer 角色登录。只能看到分派给自己的内容。

You own
Going through the submissions given to you, one at a time.
You decide
Whether each file belongs in the pack — only where the machine got it wrong. Everything else stands.
You must not
Assign work, approve a submission, or open one nobody gave you.
You are finished when
You press Confirm. That is your review.
你负责
把分派给你的 Submission，一份一份看完。
你决定
每个文件该不该进材料包 —— 只改机器判错的，其余保持原样。
你不可以
分派工作、审批 Submission、或打开没有分给你的 Submission。
做完的标志
你按下 Confirm。那就是你的审阅。

Admin

管理员（admin）

Signs in as admin. Sees and may write everything.

以 admin 角色登录。所有内容都能看、都能写。

You own
Accounts, who is given what, the address the app answers on, and getting the answers safely off the workstation.
You may
Review any submission and approve any submission. You also get the aggregate figures and the back-office screens.
You must not
Read a rate off the screen and call it accuracy. See what the numbers mean.
Your standing job
Pack the results at the end of any day people reviewed — nothing does it for you.
你负责
账号、谁做哪一份、应用对外的地址，以及把答案安全地从工作站带出来。
你可以
审阅任何一份 Submission，也可以审批任何一份。 汇总数字和后台界面也都归你看。
你不可以
把屏幕上的某个比率直接当成「准确率」对外说。见 这些数字能说明什么。
你的日常职责
只要当天有人审过，收工时就把结果打包带走 —— 没有任何东西会自动替你做。

Developer

开发人员（developer）

Signs in as developer. Sees everything an admin sees.

以 developer 角色登录。admin 看到的都能看到。

You own
Looking. Diagnosing. Changing the code, elsewhere.
You may
Read every submission and every aggregate figure.
You cannot
Write anything — not a ruling, not a confirmation, not an account.
You are finished when
You have seen what you came to see. Nothing here records.
你负责
查看、排查问题；改代码是在别处改。
你可以
查看每一份 Submission 和所有汇总数字。
你做不到
写入任何东西 —— 裁定、确认、账号都不行。
做完的标志
看完你要看的。这里不会记录任何内容。

The Submission Agent

Submission Agent（机器）

Not a person, and not a role. It has already run before anybody signs in.

不是人，也不是一种角色。在任何人登录之前，它已经跑完了。

It owns
A first answer on every file, and the rule it cites for that answer. The colour — whether the submission can be passed on to downstream — is graded off them.
It decides
Its answer on a file is the default and you may take it away. The colour is not a suggestion: a green submission goes downstream with nobody reading it first.
It must not
Be treated as the answer a person is scored against.
What it needs from you
The sentence you type when you overrule it.
它负责
给每个文件一个初判，并写明依据的是哪条规则。 这份 Submission 能不能交付下游 —— 即颜色 —— 依据这些评定。
它决定
它对单个文件的答案只是默认值，你可以拿掉； 但颜色不是建议：绿色的 Submission 会在没有人看过的情况下交付下游。
不可以
把它当成给人打分的标准答案。
它需要你给的
你推翻它时写下的那句话。

Reviewing and approving are jobs, not roles

「审阅」和「审批」是任务，不是角色

Your role does not change. The job on each submission does: review it, approve it, or neither. An admin may do both jobs; a reviewer does one.

你的角色不会变。每份 Submission 上的任务会变： 审阅、审批，或两者都不是。admin 两种都能做；reviewer 只做一种。

JobWhat finishing it means
Review You went through it and confirmed. That makes it reviewed. Two reviewers means two people were asked — one confirmation is enough.
Approve You read what the reviewers said and confirmed. You hold the final verdict where they differ. Optional.
任务做完意味着什么
审阅 你过了一遍并按了确认，就算已审阅。 两位审阅人只表示请了两个人 —— 确认一次即可。
审批 你读了审阅意见并按了确认。他们看法不同的， 以你为准。可选。
One role each, and one rule about jobs 每人一种角色，任务只有一条规则

Each person has one role. Jobs are per submission. You cannot review and approve the same submission.

每个人只有一种角色。任务按 Submission 分。 不能在同一份Submission 上既审又批。

AWhich setup is yours — read this first你属于哪一种部署 —— 先看这个

There are two ways to run this. Pick yours and the rest of the page follows.

有两种用法都称为「flywheel」。选择属于你的那一种，页面会随之切换。

What the two actually are

这两种到底是什么

SetupWhat runsSign-in Who can use it
A — this machine python flywheel\validate\serve.py on one machine No — it is just you at that keyboard Whoever is sitting at that machine
B — hosted The same program, plus a flywheel\validate\server_config.json Yes, everybody Anyone the config gives an account
部署运行的是什么需要登录吗 谁能使用
A — 本机 在一台机器上运行 python flywheel\validate\serve.py 不需要 —— 因为不存在「谁」的概念 坐在那台机器前的人
B — 服务端 同一个程序，外加一个 flywheel\validate\server_config.json 需要，所有人都需要 配置文件里有账号的人
The one rule that decides it 决定一切的那一条规则

The file flywheel\validate\server_config.json turns sign-in on. Create it and everybody signs in; delete it and the app goes back to this machine only. On every machine except the one server, that file is absent — no sign-in.

是否需要登录，取决于 flywheel\validate\server_config.json 是否存在。 存在则全员登录；不存在则仅本机。 除服务器外，每台机器目前都没有这个文件 —— 不登录。

BThe two words that cause the most confusion最容易混淆的两个词

WordWhat it is What it is not
An account A name and a password. It lets you in. It does not give you work. An account with no assignment sees an empty queue — ask the project team.
An assignment A line in the assignment list (assignments.csv) saying who reviews a submission, and who approves it if anybody does. It gives you work. It is not a login. A name on the list with no account cannot sign in at all.
词它是什么 它不是什么
账号 由名字和密码组成，供你登录使用。 它不会给你工作。只有账号、没有分派，登录后队列是空的 —— 请联系项目组。
分派 分派清单（assignments.csv）里的一行， 写明谁审、谁签核。它给你工作。 它不是登录凭证。名字在清单上但没有账号的人，无法登录。

You need both. Accounts hold passwords and stay on the server. The assignment list is edited where the reviewing happens, and rides back to the coding PC in the results zip.

两者都要有。账号含密码，留在服务器上； 分派清单在审阅所在的机器上编辑，随结果压缩包带回开发机。

Not this one 请勿混淆

setup.json in a treaty folder is not about people. Reviewers do not need it.

合约文件夹中的 setup.json 与人员无关。 审阅人员无需理会。

1Open it打开

Someone sends you an address. Everything happens in the browser; there is nothing to install.

有人会发给你一个网址。一切都在浏览器中进行，无需安装任何软件。

关于截图

界面截图是英文的，因为应用本身就是英文界面。 下文提到按钮和栏目时，会附上屏幕上的英文原词。

No sign-in page? 没看到登录页？

You are on Setup A. Skip to the review screen. There is no My work card — work from the rail.

说明你使用的是部署 A，无需登录，直接进入审阅界面。 没有 My work（我的工作） —— 从左侧清单开始。

The session ends by itself after a while of doing nothing. You lose nothing: every answer is saved the moment you press it, not when you leave.

闲置一段时间后会自动登出，但不会丢失任何内容： 每个答案在按下的一刻即已保存，而非离开时才保存。

2Find your work找到你的工作

You land here. It shows only what has been given to you.

登录后首先进入此页。只显示分派给你的内容。

The colour beside every submission

每份 Submission 旁边的那个颜色

The colour says whether this submission can be passed on to downstream. It never changes a file's role. It says what has to happen before the pack goes on — nothing, a double check, or an investigation.

颜色说的是这份 Submission 能不能交付下游。 它不改变任何文件的判定，只说明在交付之前还要做什么 —— 什么都不用做、有人复核一下，或者先查清楚。

ColourWhat it is telling you
Not trusted (red)Find out what happened before any of it is passed on. The submission screen names what fired.
Check first (amber)Somebody looks before it goes on. Clear the files the submission screen names, then confirm the submission; where it names none, the double check is of the submission itself, and the confirmation clears it.
Ships as is (green)Nothing is left to check: ready to go downstream.
颜色它在告诉你什么
Not trusted 不可信（红） 先查清楚出了什么问题，在此之前任何内容都不往下游送。 Submission 界面会写明是哪几条规则触发的。
Check first 先查一下（黄） 交付之前要有人复核：处理 Submission 界面上点名的文件，再确认这份 Submission； 一个文件都没点名时，要复核的就是这份 Submission 本身，确认即可消除。
Ships as is 可原样放行（绿） 没有待查的内容，可直接交付下游。

Your review moves it — a submission you are reviewing here. The colour is graded again after every answer, confirmation, flag and take-back, and the lamps show it at once. Where it is not green, the submission screen says why under its header. A file you answer leaves every line that named it. The lines about the submission as a whole go when the confirmation that finishes it is in: the approver's where one is named, otherwise yours. Answer what the lines name, confirm, and it goes green.

你的审阅会改变这个颜色 —— 指你在这里审阅的 Submission。 每次作答、确认、标记或撤回之后，颜色都会重新评定，灯随即变化。 不是绿色时，Submission 界面在标题栏下写明原因。 作答过的文件，从点名它的每一条里退出。针对整份 Submission 的条目， 在算数的确认到位后消除：指定了批准人的，是批准人的确认；否则是你的。 把条目点名的文件答完，再确认，颜色就会变绿。

Empty screen? 界面一片空白？

You have an account but no assignment. Ask the project team to give you work.

有账号但没有分派。请联系项目组给你工作。

3The review screen审阅界面

This is where the work happens. The machine has already answered every row; you are looking for the ones it got wrong.

审阅工作就在这个界面完成。机器已经给每一行填好了答案； 你要找的，是它填错的那几行。

The document beside the row

行旁边的文件

When the document is in its own window 文件在独立窗口里时

A line at the top of the list says so, with bring it back and close. The window itself carries unpin, back to the panel and a close cross. unpin moves it to an ordinary window — one you can minimise.

清单上方会有一行说明，并带 bring it back（放回原处） 和 close（关闭）。窗口本身带 unpin（取消置顶）、 back to the panel（放回面板） 和一个关闭叉。 unpin 会把它换成一个可以最小化的普通窗口。

Read this once and the screen makes sense 看懂这一段，就理解了整个界面

Start with Dropped. That is where a wrongly discarded file hides. Move faster through Proposed to keep.

从 Dropped（剔除） 开始 —— 误删的文件在这里。 Proposed to keep（建议保留） 可以较快过。

4The buttons on a row每一行上的按钮

Three fixed positions on every row, always in the same order, always naming what happens to the file.

每行三个按钮，位置和顺序固定， 按钮名称始终表示该文件的去向。

ButtonWhat it means
DropThis file does not belong in the pack. Whether the machine already thought so or not.
KeepThis file does belong in the pack.
FlagSomebody else should look. Not a verdict.
按钮含义
Drop（剔除）该文件不应进入材料包。 无论机器原本是否也如此判定。
Keep（保留）该文件应进入材料包。
Flag（标记）请他人再看一眼。不是裁定。

The one already highlighted is the machine's answer. Pressing it again takes your answer back and leaves the row as the machine had it.

高亮显示的是机器的答案。再次按下即撤回你的意见， 恢复机器原判。

A flag belongs to whoever raised it 标记属于举手的那个人

Only the person who flagged a row can take the flag off. On somebody else's flag the row says who, and offers no button.

只有当初做标记的人才能取消。 别人做的标记，行内会写明是谁，并且没有按钮。

5When you have to give a reason什么时候必须写理由

Contradicting the machine takes one click and, sometimes, one sentence.

推翻机器的判定，只需一次点击 —— 有时还需一句话。

Type it, then press — in that order 先输入内容，再按按钮 —— 顺序不能颠倒

The comment box is read at the moment you press a button. Type your sentence first, then press Drop, Keep or Flag. Clicking away to another row before pressing loses what you typed.

备注在按下按钮的那一刻才会被读取。 请先输入内容，再按 Drop、Keep 或 Flag。 若未按就切换到其他行，已输入的内容会丢失。

6The keyboard键盘操作

KeyDoes
↓ ↑Next file, previous file
dDrop it
kKeep it
fFlag it for somebody to look at
cClear — take your answer back
/Jump to the search box
EscLeave the search box
[Fold the list away, and bring it back
按键作用
↓ ↑下一个 / 上一个文件
d剔除（Drop）
k保留（Keep）
f标记，请人来看（Flag）
c撤回你的答案（Clear）
/跳到搜索框
Esc离开搜索框
[收起 / 展开左侧清单

The keys are printed under the search box — all but [.

这些按键印在搜索框下方 —— [ 除外。

7Confirm确认

The one thing to get right 唯一不能出错的一件事

A submission you did not confirm counts for nothing, however many rows you marked. Confirming is what says a person went through it.

未经确认的 Submission 一律无效，无论标记了多少行。 确认才表示有人完整审阅过。

The green button says how many files you are approving and under whose name. Press it when you have been through the submission — not when you have touched every row.

绿色按钮写明核准的文件数和名义。 审阅完这份 Submission 即可按下 —— 无需每行都处理。

What you are agreeing to

你确认的到底是什么

The three counts above the button: decided by hand, flagged, left as proposed. They add up to the whole submission.

按钮上方的三个数字：人工判定、标记、保持原判。 三者之和即整份 Submission。

Changing your mind afterwards

事后改变主意

Reopen the submission and press again. Nothing is overwritten: a new answer is appended, and the newest one from you counts.

重新打开这份 Submission，再按一次。不会覆盖：记录只会追加， 以你自己最新的答案为准。

If the documents change under you 如果文件在你确认之后发生变化

If the machine sorts the submission again after you confirmed, your approval is marked out of date. Go through it and confirm again.

确认后若这份 Submission 被重新分类，核准会标为已过期。 再过一遍并重新确认。

8Glossary — the words on the screen词汇表 —— 界面上那些词

In the rail, under My work. What each label means, and the rules in the order they are tried. The first match wins.

在左侧清单的 My work 下方。每个标签的含义， 以及规则的尝试顺序。先匹配上的那条生效。

Worth a look before your first submission: what the machine can say about a file (only Core goes in the pack), whether it could read it, what kind of document it thinks it is, and the rules, in the order they are tried.

第一份 Submission 前值得看一眼：机器对一个文件能说什么 （只有 Core 进材料包）、它能不能读出内容、 它认为这是哪一类文档，以及规则序列。

The one that goes wrong most often 最常出错的那一条

The rule that keeps a file for what it is reads its own name, then the title at the top of its text or a workbook's sheet names. It usually goes wrong on a name or a title: say that in the comment. A file whose own words make it neither a contract nor a submission document is kept on the folder alone, and the table says so (kept on the folder alone). A file outside the two submission folders is not ruled on, and the table names the folder it sits in.

按类型判定 Core 的规则，先看文件自己的名称，再看正文顶部的标题或 工作簿的工作表名称。出错多半在名称或标题上：在备注里写明即可。自身用词 既不表明是合约文档、也不表明是 Submission 文档的文件，仅凭文件夹保留，表里会 写明（仅凭文件夹保留）。在两个 Submission 文件夹之外的文件不作判定，表里注明 所在文件夹。

1Start the server启动服务

One command. What it does depends entirely on whether a configuration file exists.

一条命令。其行为完全取决于配置文件是否存在。

# Setup A - this machine only, no sign-in
python flywheel\validate\serve.py

# No store on this machine: let filenames open the actual document
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --store-config none --files-root "C:\raw\<round>"

# Does everything on disk hold together? Opens no port, writes nothing
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check

# Invented submissions, for a machine with no documents at all
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --mock
# 部署 A - 仅本机，不登录
python flywheel\validate\serve.py

# 本机没有文件库：让文件名可以点开实际文档
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --store-config none --files-root "C:\raw\<round>"

# 数据自身是否自洽？不开端口，不写入任何内容
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check

# 一套虚构数据，供完全没有文档的机器使用
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --mock
With a store, the documents open out of it 配置了文件库时，文件从文件库中打开

Where contract\store_config.json names a store, a filename opens the document out of the store, and the pane beside the row shows what the machine read of it. --files-root is refused then. With no store, --files-root names the folder holding the documents, and no reading is shown: the words are in the store. Without either the filenames are plain text — the app is served over http, where a file:// link fails silently, so it does not offer one.

配置了文件库（contract\store_config.json）时， 点击文件名即从文件库中打开文档，行旁的面板显示机器读到的内容； 此时 --files-root 会被拒绝。没有文件库时， 用 --files-root 指定存放文档的文件夹， 也不显示机器读到的内容 —— 那些文字在文件库里。两者都没有时， 文件名只是文字：http 环境下 file:// 链接会静默失效， 因此应用干脆不提供。

2Turn on sign-in (Setup B)开启登录（部署 B）

Five steps, in this order. Steps 1–3 run on the coding PC; the result travels to the server in the code zip.

共五步，按顺序执行。第 1–3 步在开发机上完成， 结果随代码压缩包带到服务器。

  1. Make the accounts. Each command asks for a password twice and writes nothing else. 
    python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "First Admin" --role admin
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "Second Admin" --role admin
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "A. Reviewer" --role reviewer
    The first one creates flywheel\validate\server_config.json — which is the act that turns sign-in on.
  2. Say where it answers. Open that file and set bind to the server's address. Leave it as loopback and only that machine can reach it.
  3. Assign the work — see the next section. An account without an assignment signs in to an empty screen.
  4. Ship it. python tools\bundle.py code carries the accounts file out to the workstation. It prints a line telling you it is doing so, because carrying accounts turns sign-in on over there.
  5. Start it on the server and give people the address.
  1. 创建账号。每条命令会要求输入两次密码，不写入其他内容。 
    python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "First Admin" --role admin
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "Second Admin" --role admin
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --add-account "A. Reviewer" --role reviewer
    第一条会创建 flywheel\validate\server_config.json —— 正是这个动作开启了登录。
  2. 指定对外地址。打开该文件，将 bind 设为服务器地址。 若保持默认本机地址，则仅本机可以访问。
  3. 分派工作 —— 见下一节。有账号但无分派的人，登录后将看到空界面。
  4. 发布。python tools\bundle.py code 会将账号文件带到工作站， 并打印一行提示 —— 因为将账号带过去即等于在那边开启了登录。
  5. 在服务器上启动，然后把地址发给大家。
RoleSeesCan write
reviewerOnly the submissions assigned to them Rulings and confirmations on those
adminEverything, plus Progress, Reviewer activity, Rules feedback, Assign work and Accounts Everything: reviews any, approves any
developerThe same screens as admin Nothing at all — refused at the server
角色能看到能写入
reviewer（审阅人）只有分派给他的 Submission 这些 Submission 上的裁定和确认
admin（管理员）全部，另加 Progress（进度）、 Reviewer activity（审阅人活动）、Rules feedback（规则反馈）、 Assign work（分派工作）和 Accounts（账号） 全部：任何一份都能审、都能批
developer（开发）界面和 admin 一样 不允许任何写入 —— 服务端直接拒绝
Refused, not hidden 是拒绝，不是隐藏

A reviewer asking for another reviewer's submission, its documents, or a write against it is refused by the server — not merely left off their screen. And the name recorded against every answer is taken from the sign-in, never from what the page sent.

审阅人请求他人的 Submission、文档，或对其写入， 均被服务端拒绝 —— 而非仅在界面上不显示。 每个答案记录的名字取自登录身份，绝不取自页面发来的内容。

Trying it without committing to it

先试用，不做实际改动

Point the app at a throwaway config and invented submissions, which come with a throwaway store of their own in a temporary folder. Nothing is written into the repository and no real document is involved:

将应用指向一个临时配置和一套虚构数据； 虚构数据自带一个放在临时文件夹里的临时文件库。 不写入代码库，也不涉及真实文档。

python flywheel\validate\serve.py --mock --config C:\tmp\try.json --add-account "Ann" --role reviewer
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --mock --config C:\tmp\try.json

Delete C:\tmp\try.json and it never happened.

删除 C:\tmp\try.json，即可视为从未发生。

3Assign the work分派工作

Who reviews what, how much each person is carrying, and who was given work they cannot open.

谁审阅哪一份、每个人手上有多少、 以及谁被分了工作却打不开。

The shapes that are allowed

允许的几种组合

ShapeWhat it means Finished when
One reviewerOne person reads it. The common case. They confirm
Two reviewers Two people were asked, and read it independently. Neither signs the other off, and a document they answer differently stays contested. Either confirms
Reviewer(s) + approver The approver reads what they said and holds the final verdict on anything they disagreed about. The approver confirms
Nobody namedNot a shape — every submission needs a reviewer. The screen says how many are still like this. Never
组合含义 何时算完成
一位审阅人一个人读它。最常见的情况。 他确认后
两位审阅人 请了两个人各自独立读它。谁也不为谁签字； 两人答案不同的文件保持「有分歧」状态。 任一人确认后
审阅人 + 审批人 审批人读完他们的意见，并对有分歧的文件拥有最终裁定权。 审批人确认后
均未填写这不算一种组合 —— 每份 Submission 都必须有审阅人。 界面会显示还有多少份是这种状态。 永远不会
Refused, and why 会被拒绝的写法，以及原因

Nobody may approve their own review. Two rows of one submission naming different approvers is refused as well.

不允许给自己的审阅做审批。 同一份 Submission 写了不同的审批人，也会被拒绝。

Behind the screen it is one file three columns wide: the store's review\assignments.csv, or data\_overview\assignments.csv on a machine with no store. You can edit it by hand instead; the app reads it fresh on every request.

界面背后是一个三列的文件：文件库里的 review\assignments.csv；没有文件库的机器上是 data\_overview\assignments.csv。 可直接手工编辑；应用每次请求都会重新读取。

tno,reviewer,approver
99901-2026,A. Reviewer,
99904-2026,A. Reviewer,The project team
99906-2026,A. Reviewer,
99906-2026,Second Reviewer,

Three shapes: one reviewer, one reviewer with an approver over them, and two reviewers with nobody over them. The approver column is repeated on every row of its submission, and may be blank.

三种形态：一位审阅人；一位审阅人加一位审批人； 两位审阅人、上面没有人。审批人这一列会在该 Submission 的每一行重复写，也可以留空。

4All treaties — the overview dashboardAll treaties —— 总览看板

The project team's landing screen. Where the book stands, how much was filtered, and how the machine is doing.

项目组的首页：整体进展、筛除量与机器表现。

5Progress — who has whatProgress（进度）—— 每份 Submission 在谁手上

One board, grouped by what needs doing. The exceptions are at the top and the finished work is at the bottom, so the first thing you read is the thing to act on.

一块看板，按「需要做什么」分组： 例外情况在最上面，已完成的在最下面 —— 你最先读到的，就是需要处理的那一件。

Two people on one submission appear as two names in who has it. Reviewed is the status of the submission, not of a person: one assigned reviewer confirming is enough, unless an approver was named, in which case it waits for them.

一份 Submission 分派给两个人时，who has it（在谁手上） 一栏会列出两个名字。Reviewed（已审阅）说的是这份 Submission 的状态， 而不是某个人的状态：只要有一位被分派的审阅人确认即可； 若指定了审批人，则要等审批人确认。

6Accounts账号

Who can sign in, what each of them is holding, and who was given work but has no account at all.

谁可以登录、每个人手上有多少， 以及谁分到了活却根本没有账号。

Where you make an account matters 在哪台机器上创建账号，结果不同

Accounts you add on the server are replaced by the next code zip, because it carries the coding PC's copy of the file. Either add people on the coding PC and ship, or point the server at a config outside the code folder with --config. Disabling someone takes effect on their very next request, not at their next sign-in.

在服务器上创建的账号会被下一个代码包覆盖 —— 它携带的是开发机上的那份。 要么在开发机上创建后再发布，要么用 --config 指向代码目录之外的配置文件。 停用即时生效，无需等待对方重新登录。

7Reviewer activity, and Rules feedbackReviewer activity 与 Rules feedback

How to read it

怎么读这个界面

The answers given in this app are shown twice, once per direction, and the dangerous one comes first:

在本应用中给出的答案分成两个方向各列一次， 危险的那个方向排在前面：

BlockWhat a row in it costs
Rules that dropped a file somebody kept The expensive direction. Nothing downstream catches a document triage discarded — if the rule is wrong, the document is simply gone.
Rules that kept a file somebody dropped A precision defect. The pack is fatter than it should be, and somebody downstream reads a page they did not need to.
区块其中一行意味着什么代价
Rules that dropped a file somebody kept （剔除了别人要保留的文件的规则） 代价高的那个方向。分类阶段丢掉的文件，下游没有任何环节能发现 —— 规则若判错，文件就真的没了。
Rules that kept a file somebody dropped （保留了别人要剔除的文件的规则） 精度问题：材料包比应有的更厚，下游有人要多读一份用不上的东西。

An empty block is still drawn, so it is not mistaken for a check that never ran.

空的区块也会画出来，以免看起来像没做这项检查。

ColumnWhat it counts
AnsweredFiles this rule touched that somebody has since ruled on or approved by confirming.
The person agreedOf those, how many they left as the rule had them.
Wanted back / not keptOf those, how many they overturned. This is the number the rule is judged on.
Still openFiles that rule touched which nobody has answered yet. Beside the figures, never inside them — an unfinished book must not make a rule look worse than it is. More open than answered and the row is marked provisional: early, not wrong.
列它数的是什么
Answered（已作答） 这条规则处理过、且已有人裁定或按确认核准的文件数。
The person agreed（人同意） 其中有多少维持了规则的判定。
Wanted back（要回来） / not kept（没留） 其中有多少被人推翻。评价一条规则，看的就是这个数。
Still open（还没答） 这条规则处理过、但还没人作答的文件数。它列在各项数字旁边， 绝不计入其中 —— 书没读完，不该让规则显得比实际更差。 未答多于已答时，该行标为 provisional（暂定）：是早，不是错。
MVP20 and MVP3 are not in these figures MVP20 和 MVP3 不在这些数字里

Answered in this app is somebody who could see the machine's call before they answered. The analysts who selected MVP20 and MVP3 by hand could not: tools/score/mvp20.py scores the rules against those answers, outside this app, and no figure here adds the two together.

Answered in this app（在本应用中作答） 指作答者当时能看到机器的判断。手工挑选 MVP20、MVP3 的分析人员看不到：规则按那些答案由 tools/score/mvp20.py 在本应用之外评分，这里的任何数字都不把两者相加。

8What the numbers mean — and what they do not这些数字能说明什么、不能说明什么

FigureHow to read it
Checked here agreement Agreement, not correctness. The reviewer saw the machine's answer first, so it drifts high.
How much was filtered How much work the machine took off the pile. Not an accuracy figure, which is why it sits apart from the grid.
MVP20 and MVP3 Scored by tools/score/mvp20.py against the analysts' fixed answers, who did not see the machine's. Never added to a figure here.
Untouched but confirmed Reported separately from rows a person actually stopped on. The blended rate is withheld rather than published with a footnote.
Progress Against the treaties the machine has sorted, counted off the disk. Not the size of the book, and the total moves as more are sorted.
What the colour says A breakdown, not a journey. A colour moves when it is graded again: at the app's start and after every answer.
Changed, on Reviewer activity Not a score for the person. A high figure is about the machine first. People given different work will differ here.
数字如实的解读
Checked here 的一致率 这是一致率，不是正确率。审阅人先看到机器答案，因此偏高。
筛掉了多少 反映机器筛除的工作量。不是准确率 —— 因此与一致率表分开呈现。
MVP20 和 MVP3 由 tools/score/mvp20.py 按分析人员的固定答案评分， 他们没有看过机器答案。绝不计入这里的任何数字。
未改动但被确认的 与「人真正处理过的行」分开报告。 混合比率宁可不发布，也不加脚注充数。
进度 分母是从磁盘统计的已分类合约数，并非业务盘子； 每多分类一个，总数即变化。
What the colour says（颜色的判定） 这是构成分布，不是进度。颜色在重新评定时才变：应用启动时，以及每次作答之后。
Reviewer activity 上的 Changed 这不是对人的评分。数值高，首先是关于机器的发现。 分到不同工作的人，这个数字自然不同。

9Where the answers go, and how to check them答案存到哪里，以及怎么检查

review\<round>\<TNO>\validations-<reviewer>.csv  one file per person, in the store
data\<TNO>\validations\validations-<reviewer>.csv    the same, on a machine with no store

Append-only: nothing is ever rewritten. Each person has their own file, and "newest wins" is a rule about one person — across two people there is no newest, and a disagreement stays a disagreement until an approver settles it, on the submissions that have one.

只追加，不改写。每人一个文件； 「以最新为准」仅适用于同一个人 —— 两人之间不存在「最新」，分歧保持原样， 直到审批人做出裁定（在有审批人的 Submission 上）。

These files ride back in the results zip and are committed. They hold paths, verdicts and the reviewer's own words — conclusions, at the same sensitivity as everything else in the repository. No client document is among them.

这些文件随结果压缩包带回并入库：内容为路径、裁定和审阅人写下的文字， 均属结论，敏感度与代码库其他内容相同，不含任何客户文档。

# structural checks over the real submissions; opens no port
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check

# every suite in the repository, one command
python test_all.py
# 对真实数据做结构性检查；不开端口
python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check

# 一条命令执行代码库中的全部测试
python test_all.py
Back the answers up 记得将答案带出来

The only copy of a reviewer's work is on the workstation share until somebody runs python tools\bundle.py results by hand. Nothing schedules that. Pack the results at the end of any day people reviewed.

在有人手工执行 python tools\bundle.py results 之前， 审阅成果仅存于工作站共享盘上的一份。 没有定时任务执行此操作。当天只要有人审阅，当天工作结束时就应打包。

?If something stops出问题时

What you seeWhat it is
No sign-in page, no My work You are on Setup A. There is no configuration file, so there is nobody to sign in as. This is normal on every machine but the server.
Signed in, but the screen is empty An account with no assignment. Add them to assignments.csv.
Filenames are plain text and do not open With a store: its drive is not on this machine, and the startup lines say so. With no store: the server was started without --files-root. Restart it with the folder holding the documents.
"The address is already in use" An older copy is still running. Stop it, then start this one.
An approval says out of date The submission was triaged again after it was confirmed. Go through it and confirm again.
Somebody's password needs resetting Accounts screen, or --add-account with the same name on the coding PC.
The whole app will not start Run python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check. It opens no port and tells you what on disk it cannot make sense of.
你看到的现象原因
没有登录页，也没有 My work 部署 A：没有配置文件，也就不存在「谁」的概念。 除服务器外皆如此，属正常。
能登录，但界面空白 有账号无分派。将该人员加入 assignments.csv。
文件名是纯文字，无法点开 配置了文件库时：文件库所在的盘不在本机，启动信息里会写明。 没有文件库时：启动时未加 --files-root。 请带上存放文档的文件夹重启。
提示地址已被占用 仍有旧实例在运行。先停掉它，再启动这个。
某个核准显示 out of date（已过期） 确认后又被重新分类。再过一遍并重新确认。
要给某人重置密码 使用账号界面，或在开发机上用同一个名字执行 --add-account。
应用完全无法启动 执行 python flywheel\validate\serve.py --check。 它不开端口，会指出磁盘上哪一部分无法读取。
